stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-5.3 Instant with fewer refusals and 'less cringe' responses
key_facts: GPT-5.3 Instant released March 3, 2026 as the new default ChatGPT model, available to all users and via API as gpt-5.3-chat-latest
Reduces unnecessary refusals on safe questions, particularly around sensitive topics, and cuts defensive or moralizing preambles
Improves web search synthesis by balancing online findings with internal reasoning and surfacing key information upfront
OpenAI evaluated using two internal benchmarks and noted improvements 'don't necessarily show up in benchmarks' but affect perceived helpfulness
Launch comes as rival Claude surpassed ChatGPT in U.S. phone app downloads for the first time, per Sensor Tower data

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite at $0.25/M tokens — 2.5x faster than predecessor
key_facts: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite launched March 3, 2026 in preview via Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Vertex AI
Priced at $0.25 per million input tokens and $1.50 per million output tokens — one-eighth the cost of Gemini 3.1 Pro
Outperforms Gemini 2.5 Flash with 2.5x faster Time to First Answer Token and 45% increase in output speed per Artificial Analysis benchmark
Scores 1432 Elo on Arena.ai Leaderboard, 86.9% on GPQA Diamond, and 76.8% on MMMU Pro — surpassing prior-gen larger Gemini models
Supports text, image, video, audio, and PDF input with 1M token context; includes configurable 'thinking levels' for adjustable reasoning depth
Gemini 3 Pro Preview simultaneously deprecated with March 9 shutdown; gemini-pro-latest alias moves to 3.1 Pro on March 6

stories.headline: DeepSeek V4 still imminent as China's Two Sessions open; model optimized for Huawei chips
key_facts: DeepSeek V4 has not yet launched as of March 4 but is expected imminently, timed to coincide with China's Two Sessions parliamentary meetings starting March 4

key_facts: OpenAI is developing an internal code-hosting platform to compete with Microsoft's GitHub, per The Information report on March 4
Project prompted by frequent GitHub service disruptions that affected OpenAI's engineering teams in recent months
Still in early stages and likely months from completion; employees have considered selling the repository to OpenAI customers

stories.headline: Lockheed Martin and defense contractors purging Anthropic's Claude after Trump supply-chain ban
key_facts: U.S. defense contractors including Lockheed Martin expected to remove Anthropic's AI tools from supply chains following Trump administration ban
10 defense-tech portfolio companies at J2 Ventures have already backed off Claude for defense use cases and are actively replacing it
Trump ordered all federal agencies to 'immediately cease' using Anthropic technology with six-month phase-out; Hegseth designated Anthropic a 'supply chain risk'
Legal scholars question whether the government has authority to also bar Anthropic's general use by private defense contractors
Anthropic said it will challenge the ban in court once it receives formal notice of penalties

key_facts: OpenAI is considering a contract to deploy its AI technology on NATO's unclassified networks, per Reuters citing a person familiar with the matter
Wall Street Journal first reported that Sam Altman initially told a company meeting it was looking to deploy on 'all NATO classified networks'
OpenAI spokeswoman later clarified Altman misspoke — the contract opportunity is for NATO's unclassified networks only

stories.headline: Endor Labs launches AURI: free security layer for AI coding agents after study finds only 10% of AI code is secure
key_facts: Endor Labs launched AURI on March 3, a security intelligence platform that embeds real-time vulnerability detection into AI coding agent workflows
Free for individual developers; integrates natively with Cursor, Claude, and Augment via Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Addresses finding from Carnegie Mellon, Columbia, and Johns Hopkins research that only 10% of AI-generated code is both functionally correct and secure
Combines agentic reasoning with deterministic static analysis to generate, review, and remediate code in a unified environment
90% of development teams now use AI coding assistants, but leading models produce functionally correct code only 61% of the time
Endor Labs has raised over $208M in venture funding; CEO Varun Badhwar previously founded RedLock (acquired by Palo Alto Networks)

key_facts: SigmaticOS launched March 3 at the Lab of the Future USA Conference in Boston as the 'only complete lab-in-the-loop platform for all scientists'
Features 100+ AI agents for orchestrating in silico workflows and lab automation with full traceability
Integrates LLM, RLM, RAG, and model training natively, connecting wet and dry lab workflows in one platform
AI spending in life science R&D predicted to accelerate from $4B in 2025 to $20B by 2030, already reducing preclinical drug development timelines by up to 40%
Biopharma organizations currently operate with 840+ disconnected applications; SigmaticOS aims to unify these silos

stories.headline: Google, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon and others sign White House pledge to self-power AI data centers
key_facts: Google, Microsoft, Meta, Oracle, xAI, OpenAI, and Amazon will sign the Ratepayer Protection Pledge at the White House on March 4-5
Companies commit to build, bring, or buy their own power supply for new AI data centers so Americans' electricity bills will not increase
Pledge ensures infrastructure and power delivery expenses are not passed on to the public
Companies also commit to hiring and training workers from communities where data centers operate
AWS CEO Matt Garman said the pledge establishes a clear baseline to protect ratepayers while enabling responsible long-term energy partnerships
Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the pledge aims to stop rising electricity prices while ensuring the US wins the AI race

stories.headline: NASA fixes Artemis II SLS helium blockage, preserves April 2026 lunar flyby launch window
key_facts: Engineers identified a dislodged seal in a quick-disconnect fitting that blocked helium flow to the ICPS upper stage during the February 20-21 wet dress rehearsal
Technicians removed the quick-disconnect, repositioned the seal, and confirmed helium was flowing after the repair
The SLS rocket was rolled back to the Vehicle Assembly Building on February 25 for repairs after the issue could not be fixed at the launch pad
While repairing the helium system, workers also replaced batteries in the core stage, ICPS, boosters, and flight termination system
A seal in the core stage liquid oxygen feed system was also replaced, with work beginning March 2
Repairs keep a potential April 2026 launch of Artemis II on track, with the earliest possible date of April 1

stories.headline: Japan's Space One aborts Kairos No. 3 rocket launch 30 seconds before liftoff due to signal issue
key_facts: Space One aborted the Kairos No. 3 launch 30 seconds before planned liftoff from Spaceport Kii in Wakayama Prefecture on March 4
Safety monitoring system activated due to unstable signal reception from a positioning satellite
The 18-meter, 23-ton solid-fuel rocket was loaded with five satellites intended for orbit at approximately 500 km altitude
Launch has been rescheduled for Thursday with a window between 11:10 and 11:20 a.m. local time
This was the second cancellation in a week after a previous weather-related postponement
Space One's track record includes a Kairos No. 1 explosion shortly after liftoff in March 2024 and Kairos No. 2 abort three minutes after launch in December 2024

stories.headline: FDA lifts clinical hold on Intellia's CRISPR gene therapy trial for heart amyloidosis
key_facts: FDA removed clinical hold on Intellia Therapeutics' MAGNITUDE Phase 3 trial of nexiguran ziclumeran (nex-z) for ATTR-CM on March 2
Hold was placed October 29, 2025 after Grade 4 liver transaminases and elevated bilirubin observed in a patient dosed with nex-z
Separate MAGNITUDE-2 trial for hereditary ATTR with polyneuropathy had hold lifted in January 2026
New safety measures include enhanced liver monitoring, short-term steroid guidance, and exclusion of patients with ejection fraction below 25%
Nex-z is based on Nobel Prize-winning CRISPR/Cas9 technology and aims to be first one-time treatment for ATTR amyloidosis
Intellia is engaging with clinical trial investigators, ethics committees and international regulatory authorities to resume enrollment
